title: Two upright plants: same kind, or two kinds?
question: Do these read as two forms of the same kind of plant, or as two different kinds of plant?
context_md:
One of these is the shipped `tree`. The other differs from it by exactly one line -- `upward_weight` goes negative on branch orders 1 and up, so the laterals score downward steps positively and hang. Every other value is copied verbatim, so whatever you see is that one line.

**I have a stake, hence blind:** I called this one a within-class variation and sent it to the dead-end register. If you read them as two different kinds of plant, I am wrong and the register entry comes out.

Same scene, same seed, same three noon frames.
